note: Registry data not obtained. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down (connection refused) and Bing returned only irrelevant results for the exact-name queries; registry aggregators (Zauba, TheCompanyCheck, InstaFinancials, MCA master-data) returned HTTP 403 and Tofler returned 404 for the guessed URL. Therefore no LLPIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, registered state or MCA status could be confirmed from a public source, and no audited revenue figures were found. Nothing here indicates the entity does not exist - absence of accessible records is NOT grounds for rejection under the project rules, so the company is retained with role 'unknown' and all registry fields null. Needs re-check when MCA/registry access or a working search index is available; the claimed HS 847490 (parts of machinery for sorting/screening earth, stone, ores) is consistent with the claimed metallurgy/mining industry but is not verified against any actual GST registration or shipment record.
